explained.1.0: A numeric table cell: the Qt table shows the Python repr (1.0, 4.0), the emtk table the shortest number (1, 4). The values are equal.
explained.2: The Qt table's row-number header of the second spectrum row (an item-view artefact); the emtk tables have no row-number column.
explained.4.0: A numeric table cell: the Qt table shows the Python repr (1.0, 4.0), the emtk table the shortest number (1, 4). The values are equal.
explained.?: The Qt '?' help button; the emtk window has a labelled Help button (help_emtk.md) next to Guide.
explained.g: g, l1 and l2 sit in the 'VV/VH detection corrections' panel, which is folded in VM mode in both windows (the labels exist in the Qt tree while folded); the emtk form draws them when the panel is open or the mode is VV/VH.
